description: 在 MVP 基础上完成原始 PRD 剩余平台能力闭环：补齐 stdio/WebSocket/SSE、rate limiting、wrapped key revoke/rotate、optional Redis cache、Prometheus metrics、A/B canary 路由、扩展 provider 与容器化部署资产。

userStories.title: 初始化 Rust 工程与 Ralph 执行产物
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a compilable Rust project scaffold and Ralph artifacts so that the repo can move from PRD-only to executable development.
acceptanceCriteria: Cargo project exists with runnable entrypoint
prd.json and prd-progress.txt are created and aligned with MVP scope
userStories.notes: Manual Ralph-equivalent flow because the working tree is already dirty and amp/jq are unavailable.

userStories.title: 实现 env 聚合配置与可选凭据加载
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to provide only the API keys I actually have so that MCP Prism can boot and route with any supported subset of providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing provider keys disable that provider without blocking startup
userStories.notes: Covers the UX requirement that users should not have to fill every provider key.

userStories.title: 实现代理自适应 HTTP 客户端与密钥包装能力
userStories.description: As a deployer, I want proxy-aware outbound networking and wrapped client keys so that the pool runs in both proxied and direct networks with a single auth model.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports system/direct/custom proxy modes with no_proxy matching
Wrapped API key issue/validate flow works
userStories.notes: Proxy behavior must tolerate both local proxy development and direct-access VPS deployments.

userStories.title: 实现双线路由器
userStories.description: As an operator, I want small-model URL based routing with heuristic fallback so that the wrapper remains available even when the routing model path fails.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAI-compatible small-model routing path is supported
Heuristic linear fallback path covers web, academic, finance, maps and general search
userStories.notes: Fallback path must not depend on model availability.

userStories.title: 实现统一搜索模型、缓存与适配器注册表
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single request/response model and adapter registry so that all providers can plug into one execution pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: In-memory cache and adapter registry are wired into the search service
userStories.notes: Redis remains a later swap-in; MVP uses in-memory caching.

userStories.title: 完成 Web 搜索提供方模块
userStories.description: As a user, I want Brave, Tavily, Zhipu and Metaso modules so that the pool can cover global search, Chinese search and configurable experimental sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Brave, Tavily and Zhipu providers can build and normalize search responses
Metaso module exists as configurable experimental adapter
userStories.notes: Module split is based on the official endpoint groups documented in docs/PRD.

userStories.title: 完成学术、金融与地图模块
userStories.description: As a user, I want PubMed, OpenAlex, FinanceMCP and Amap modules so that the pool can answer research, finance and location tasks through the same wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: PubMed and OpenAlex search modules normalize academic results
FinanceMCP bridge and Amap operations are implemented
userStories.notes: FinanceMCP is implemented as an upstream bridge module because its upstream is itself an MCP/HTTP service.

userStories.title: 暴露 HTTP API 与 MCP tools 接口
userStories.description: As an MCP client, I want HTTP and MCP-compatible tool endpoints so that I can call the pool through a single remote entrypoint.
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP search and provider endpoints exist
MCP initialize/tools/list/tools/call are supported over JSON-RPC HTTP
userStories.notes: HTTP is the first-class remote transport for VPS deployment.

userStories.title: 同步 API、部署与环境文档
userStories.description: As a new maintainer, I want zero-to-deploy documentation so that I can configure keys, proxies and deployment without reading source code.
acceptanceCriteria: Deployment and env example docs exist
userStories.notes: Docs must explain proxy-on and proxy-off deployments.

userStories.title: 补齐测试与 .debug 进度记录
userStories.description: As a collaborator, I want tests and progress logs so that each completed phase leaves behind reusable engineering context.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit or integration tests cover routing, auth, proxy matching and API surface
.debug and prd-progress.txt are updated with learnings
userStories.notes: Every phase must leave a trace in .debug as requested.

userStories.title: 完成 PRD 差距审计与剩余 Story 重拆分
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a PRD-to-code gap analysis so that the remaining implementation work is tracked against the original architecture rather than only the MVP scaffold.
acceptanceCriteria: Gap analysis document exists under docs/architecture
Remaining work is reflected in prd.json and progress logs
userStories.notes: Manual Ralph-equivalent execution continues because amp/jq are unavailable in the current environment.

userStories.title: 补齐 MCP 传输层
userStories.description: As an MCP client, I want stdio, WebSocket and SSE transports so that Prism can run in both local and VPS-oriented remote integration modes.
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket and SSE transport endpoints exist
userStories.notes: HTTP JSON-RPC remains supported alongside the added transports.

userStories.title: 补齐鉴权运维能力
userStories.description: As an operator, I want wrapped key revoke and rotate plus client and provider rate limiting so that remote access can be controlled safely in production.
acceptanceCriteria: Client and provider rate limiting are enforced
userStories.notes: Revocation is in-memory and immediate; suitable for a single-instance deployment target.

userStories.title: 补齐缓存层
userStories.description: As an operator, I want optional Redis cache, TTL by query type, prewarm and invalidate APIs so that Prism can reduce repeated upstream calls under production traffic.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory plus optional Redis cache are available
userStories.notes: The cache remains optional so direct deployments without Redis still boot cleanly.

userStories.title: 补齐可观测性与灰度路由
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Prometheus metrics and weighted experiment routing so that I can observe traffic and canary provider strategies safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Weighted experiment routing is configurable through env
userStories.notes: OTLP/Jaeger exporter remains an optional future enhancement; metrics and structured logs are in place.

userStories.title: 补齐商业与政府扩展 provider
userStories.description: As a user, I want GitHub, Data.gov, openFDA and Census adapters so that Prism can cover more of the original PRD's Phase 4 scope with public APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: GitHub REST and GraphQL adapters exist
Data.gov, openFDA and Census adapters exist
Dynamic tool discovery exposes available provider search tools
userStories.notes: Paid or partner-only providers still require real external credentials for live verification.

userStories.title: 补齐生产部署资产
userStories.description: As a deployer, I want Docker, Compose, Nginx and Prometheus files so that the service can be stood up on a VPS directly from the repository.
userStories.notes: Deployment assets cover proxy-on and proxy-off environments.

userStories.title: 同步 Full PRD 文档与阶段记录
userStories.description: As a collaborator, I want the updated API, deployment and architecture docs plus .debug logs so that the repo state matches the expanded implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: API docs mention the new transports and admin endpoints
Deployment docs mention Redis, Prometheus and Docker artifacts
.debug and prd-progress.txt include the closeout phase
userStories.notes: Documentation now tracks the codebase beyond the initial MVP.
